A newly created Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65`, in the `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` map (`createCharacter`, `:14`), which stores item IDs; the actual names come from the `items` table rows in `worker/src/db/seed.sql`. Note: item 23 is Torches even though a code comment mislabels it as Rations (bug B-09).
